This site is the companion for a small-group workshop series that works through Scott Cunningham's free textbook [*Causal Inference: The Mixtape*](https://mixtape-1ed.netlify.app/) one research design at a time. Each session is a one-hour meeting built around the same rhythm: a short conceptual recap, a live replication of the chapter's headline result in **both Python and R**, and exercises to take home.

The book ships its code in R and Stata. Here every walkthrough is written side-by-side in Python (`pandas`, `statsmodels`, `linearmodels`) and R (`tidyverse`, `fixest`, `estimatr`), with the datasets bundled in the repo so nothing depends on a network connection during the meeting.

## Schedule

Nine sessions cover the book's eleven chapters. Short chapters are paired, and the difference-in-differences chapter is split in two because the modern staggered-timing material deserves its own hour.

| # | Session | Book chapters | Headline replication |
|---|---------|---------------|----------------------|
| 1 | [Why causal inference + regression review](sessions/01-intro-regression.qmd) | 1, 2 | Regression anatomy on `auto`; robust vs. clustered SEs |
| 2 | [Directed acyclic graphs](sessions/02-dags.qmd) | 3 | Collider bias in a simulated gender-discrimination DAG |
| 3 | [Potential outcomes](sessions/03-potential-outcomes.qmd) | 4 | Thornton's HIV experiment; Fisher randomization inference |
| 4 | [Matching & subclassification](sessions/04-matching.qmd) | 5 | Titanic subclassification; NSW/CPS propensity scores |
| 5 | [Regression discontinuity](sessions/05-rdd.qmd) | 6 | Lee, Moretti & Butler close elections |
| 6 | [Instrumental variables](sessions/06-iv.qmd) | 7 | Card's college proximity; judge-leniency design |
| 7 | [Panel data + the 2×2 difference-in-differences](sessions/07-panel-did.qmd) | 8, 9.1–9.3 | Fixed effects on the SASP panel; John Snow as a DiD |
| 8 | [DiD deep dive](sessions/08-did-deep-dive.qmd) | 9.4–9.7 | Abortion-legalization event study; castle-doctrine two-way fixed effects |
| 9 | [Synthetic control + wrap-up](sessions/09-synth-wrapup.qmd) | 10, 11 | Texas prison construction |

## How to use this site

Before the first meeting, everyone should work through [Setup](setup.qmd) so that the data loads and both toolchains run. If you are facilitating, [Facilitating](facilitating.qmd) has the 60-minute template and the norms the sessions assume. Each session page is self-contained: read **Key ideas** before the meeting, follow the **Walkthrough** live, and do the **Exercises** before the next session. Solutions and facilitator notes are collapsed at the bottom of every page so they do not spoil the exercises.

Every walkthrough chunk is executed when the site is built, so the output under each block is real, and each step also has a *What you should see* box that calls out the numbers that matter. Acronyms are spelled out on first use and collected in the [Glossary](glossary.qmd); each key idea comes with an *In plain English* restatement for anyone meeting the concept for the first time.
